title: Strings that are a number after two signs
notes: None of these is a number under the Core schema or YAML 1.1, but goccy/go-yaml reads `+-1` as a number because it strips one sign and parses the rest with a number parser that takes a sign again. A string made of a number after two or more signs is quoted. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.

provenance.reference: Strings such as +-1 written without quotes; one common reader reads +-1 as a number.
